brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.evidence: accessory:0#0,0#1, accessory:0#1,0#1, accessory:0#2,0#1 (hex-acc-keyhole on rear face slot 1 of all three level-0 cells)
requirements.requirement: Hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers

requirements.evidence: 6x hex-acc-hook plates (accessory:0#0,0#4, 0#1,0#4, 0#2,0#4 + level-1 equivalents), each plate carries two hooks; 3-wide x 2-tall rack joined with side connectors, caps and lockJoints; cable-coil prop hung on upper hook (prop:2) visible in look view; configurator wall hooks only accept cable coil / gaffer tape / FPV goggles, so pliers etc. cannot hang on them

finish.summary: 3-wide x 2-storey wall tool rack: 3 keyhole hangers on the rear face, 6 hook plates (12 hooks) across the front faces, demonstrated with a coiled cable hung on an upper hook. check_build ok, meshClash clear. Load rating / screw pull-out strength is not checked by the configurator.

lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
